t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Some gnomes are consistently good for points, so I should keep choosing them, but they change. After each rest, the good gnome colors will be different. Some gnomes are seemingly always good, though. It's all about trial and error and memory.

vb_textbox.text: For each session, there will be gnomes that consistently give you more mushrooms than the others. Pay attention to the colors. Experiment in the 1x round, so you can make the 5x rounds count. Sometimes the best gnome will have an off day and won't get you as many as normal, but loyalty will generally serve you. Don't be too hasty to abandon a gnome. Sometimes the best gnome will change within one session, but it's not as frequent as you might fear. For me, the halfway mark of a session generally meant at least one best gnome would switch up. Sometimes multiple will change, but again, loyalty is a good strategy. After each break, all the best gnomes will generally switch up, but don't be surprised if some don't. I had a mantra for the best colors and it helped. Green-purple-brown-yellow, and so on. If the best gnome has three off days in a row, I would try switching and see if your mushroom count improves. You've got this! Make some gnome friends!
